title: Long code output codec
statement: Let a family of encoded regular unique games, a finite allowed family of sign predicates, a tester using only predicates in that family, and a finite transform for this boundary be given. A long code output codec consists of an encoded maximization problem and a map sending each semantic instance in the game family to a Boolean list. Every such list is a valid instance of the encoded problem, and the optimum of that encoded instance equals the filtered long code optimum of the semantic instance under the uniform refinement, with the transform's clone count and arity bound.
hypotheses_covered: A family of encoded regular unique games
A finite set of allowed sign predicates
A tester whose checks use only allowed predicates
A long code test boundary formed by that predicate set and tester
A long code finite transform for the boundary, including its arity bound
